h:
没什么花哨的。我找不到任何对我有用的东西，所以我只是从 comfyui 示例页面中获取基本的 wan T2V 工作流程，并将其与 lora 模块结合起来，以使事情变得简单。

我上传这个是为了像我这样的人，他们只想要一个带有 lora 节点的简单 wan 工作流程，而不需要所有其他可能导致生成过程中错误的花里胡哨的东西（更不用说浪费时间和头发拉扯它造成的）！

图中使用的洛拉号是本杰明·潘恩的《威利汽船》。你可以在拥抱脸上找到这个。

o.en:
Nothing fancy. I couldn't find anything that worked for me, so I just took the basic wan T2V workflow from the comfyui example page and married it with a lora module to keep things simple.

I'm uploading this for folks like me, who just want a simple wan workflow with a lora node, without all of the other bells and whistles that can cause errors in the generation process (not to mention the wasted time and hair pulling it causes)!

The Lora used in the image is Steamboat Willie by Benjamin Paine. You can find this on Hugging Face.
